articles.content_en: Article 3 The Shanghai Financial Court shall have jurisdiction over first-instance civil and commercial cases such as securities issuance disputes, securities underwriting contract disputes, securities listing sponsorship contract disputes, securities listing contract disputes, and securities fraud liability disputes concerning companies listed on the Science and Technology Innovation Board of the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

Article 4 The Shanghai Financial Court shall have jurisdiction over first-instance financial civil and commercial cases and financial-related administrative cases in which the Shanghai Stock Exchange is the defendant or a third party and which are related to the regulatory functions of the stock exchange.

Article 5 The Shanghai Financial Court shall have jurisdiction over first-instance financial civil and commercial cases in which a financial infrastructure institution domiciled in Shanghai and established according to law is the defendant or a third party and which are related to its performance of duties.

Article 6 The Shanghai Financial Court shall have jurisdiction over first-instance financial-related administrative cases within the jurisdiction of Shanghai Municipality that shall be accepted by the Intermediate People's Court, in which actions are instituted against administrative acts taken by financial regulatory authorities and organizations authorized by laws, administrative regulations, and rules in the performance of their financial regulatory duties.

Article 7 The Shanghai Financial Court shall adjudicate appeal cases and retrial application cases filed by parties against judgments and rulings made by the Primary People's Courts of Shanghai concerning first-instance financial civil and commercial cases and financial-related administrative cases as referred to in items (1) to (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions.

Article 8 The Shanghai Financial Court shall adjudicate retrial cases of financial civil and commercial cases and financial-related administrative cases within the jurisdiction of Shanghai Municipality that shall be accepted by the Intermediate People's Court.

Article 9 The Shanghai Financial Court shall enforce the effective judgments and rulings made by the Shanghai Financial Court in first-instance civil and commercial cases and financial-related administrative cases, as well as arbitral awards concerning financial civil and commercial disputes within the jurisdiction of Shanghai Municipality that shall be enforced by the Intermediate People's Court.
The Shanghai Financial Court shall adjudicate enforcement objection cases and enforcement objection lawsuit cases arising during the enforcement process of the Shanghai Financial Court, as well as enforcement reconsideration cases and enforcement objection lawsuit appeal cases arising during the enforcement process of financial-related cases by the Primary People's Courts of Shanghai.
Article 10 Appeal cases filed by parties against first-instance judgments and rulings made by the Shanghai Financial Court shall be adjudicated by the Higher People's Court of Shanghai.

Article 11 Financial civil and commercial cases and financial-related administrative cases that have been accepted but not yet concluded by the various Intermediate People's Courts of Shanghai before the establishment of the Shanghai Financial Court shall continue to be adjudicated by those Intermediate People's Courts.
Article 12 These Provisions shall come into force on August 10, 2018.

title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction of Cases by the Shanghai Financial Court
